title: SecurityEvent
description: Canonical event schema agreed by the team in Week 1. Every module (simulator, detection, correlation, frontend) must produce/consume events matching this exact shape. Do not add or rename fields without flagging it in the weekly sync.

user.description: Username or user ID. Use 'unknown' if unauthenticated.

session.description: Session ID. Group related events under the same session.

severity.description: Normalized severity, 0.0 (benign) to 1.0 (critical). NOTE: agreed as a float 0-1, not a 1-5 int scale — confirm this in the sync, it's the #1 source of integration bugs.

metadata.description: Optional event-type-specific extra fields (e.g. endpoint, query, filename). Keep required fields above minimal and put anything module-specific here so the contract doesn't need to change every time someone needs one more field.
